Team rhythm and KPIs 	•	Daily (10-minute huddle): yesterday's sales against the daily target (workbook, Daily tab), leads called within 2 hours, trials booked, offers expiring this week. 	•	Weekly (Monday): Weekly Tracker in the workbook; conversion by associate; renewals due in the next 14 days; winback touches logged. 	•	Monthly (3rd working day): month against target by stream; offer units sold against the offer targets in this playbook; next month's offers briefed to trainers. 	•	KPIs to watch: new members per first visit (23% plan), first visits per lead (77%), renewal rate (78%), winback response (10%, to be measured), average discount, fill rate. If the studio falls behind Trigger Action Week 2 sales under 40% of the month's target Call every renewal due in the next 30 days with the month's renewal offer; push upgrades to 3-Month. Members per first visit under plan for 2 weeks Manager sits in on trial follow-ups; trials moved to weekday slots; 72-hour offer windows enforced. Leads under 80% of plan by mid-month Referral push (guest passes to every member); review the paid-ads lead quality before increasing spend. Renewal rate under plan for a month D-14 calls audited; usage calls for everyone under 25% usage; trainer check-ins at visit 4. Quarter under 95% of target Pull forward the next month's renewal offer for members expiring in the next 45 days; never add discount beyond 25%.

If the studio falls behind Trigger Action Week 2 sales under 40% of the month's target Call every renewal due in the next 30 days with the month's renewal offer; push upgrades to 3-Month. Members per first visit under plan for 2 weeks Manager sits in on trial follow-ups; trials moved to weekday slots; 72-hour offer windows enforced. Leads under 80% of plan by mid-month Referral push (guest passes to every member); review the paid-ads lead quality before increasing spend. Renewal rate under plan for a month D-14 calls audited; usage calls for everyone under 25% usage; trainer check-ins at visit 4. months.strategy: December is softer than January at every studio. Sell January starts in December, give travellers a holiday freeze, and close the year with every expiring member contacted.
months.notes:
Activation: 12 Days of Barre-mas (12–23 Dec): pop-up classes join the network activation where the format fits.
Channels: In-class conversation at Copper + Cloves and Plash Pilates, partner-venue communities, front-desk (dashboard) leads, Instagram. Studio Passport links to Kenkere House. Team rhythm and KPIs 	•	Daily (10-minute huddle): yesterday's sales against the daily target (workbook, Daily tab), leads called within 2 hours, trials booked, offers expiring this week. 	•	Weekly (Monday): Weekly Tracker in the workbook; conversion by associate; renewals due in the next 14 days; winback touches logged. 	•	Monthly (3rd working day): month against target by stream; offer units sold against the offer targets in this playbook; next month's offers briefed to trainers. 	•	KPIs to watch: new members per first visit (8% plan; pop-ups: new paying clients per first visit 94%), first visits per lead (35%), renewal rate (62%), winback response (10%, to be measured), average discount, fill rate. If the studio falls behind Trigger Action Week 2 sales under 40% of the month's target Call every renewal due in the next 30 days with the month's renewal offer; push upgrades to 3-Month. Members per first visit under plan for 2 weeks Manager sits in on trial follow-ups; trials moved to weekday slots; 72-hour offer windows enforced. Leads under 80% of plan by mid-month Referral push (guest passes to every member); review the paid-ads lead quality before increasing spend. Renewal rate under plan for a month D-14 calls audited; usage calls for everyone under 25% usage; trainer check-ins at visit 4. Quarter under 95% of target Pull forward the next month's renewal offer for members expiring in the next 45 days; never add discount beyond 25%.
